open_points.subject: send_prepared_request
open_points.text: - send_prepared_request: [VALIDATION_ERROR] A 2xx answer with value output ports must be UTF-8 text parsing as one JSON object without duplicate member names, whatever its Content-Type, whose depth, as canonical_bytes defines depth, measured on the body as a whole without recursion before it is parsed, is within the imported RELEASE_CEILING_JSON_DEPTH_MAX constant; each output port takes the member of the same name, which must exist and fit the port by fit_port_value with the imported RELEASE_CEILING_SERVICE_RESPONSE_BYTES_MAX constant as size bound, so that a value's own size is judged only by the value_too_large check below, members no port names are ignored, and any failure is contract_violation; after everything else fits, a value whose canonical bytes exceed the imported RELEASE_CEILING_STORED_VALUE_BYTES_MAX constant is contract_violation with detail value_too_large.
open_points.question: The note requires canonical_bytes to define a depth measure that can be checked, but its imported contract only returns bytes and exposes no depth value or depth-checking operation; which passage must change, or how is that depth definition made available to this module?
